findings.text: OVERDUE: Dashboard live + August scoreboard trusted milestones both missed 2026-08-31; stay/walk renewal decision now unsupported by any reliable data.

OVERDUE: Phone-match attribution gap (due 2026-08-07) and sync/contact cleanup (due 2026-08-14) both unresolved; 101 GHL opportunities created but 0 won and 0 appointments logged — intake data is untrustworthy.
Zero paid spend and zero paid leads across all 28 days; with $0 Meta and $0 Google, CPL is undefined and the scoreboard shows no attributable new patients.
GBP actions fell 33.8% week-over-week to near-zero last 3 days (0, 0, 0 vs prior 3: 15, 12, 5); 3-day signal confirms accelerating organic decay, not noise.
Search clicks dropped 69.2% week-over-week; last 3 days averaged 1 click vs prior 3 days averaging 4 — consistent with zero paid support suppressing overall search presence.
